properties.name: BEAR_WILSON_PICKWICK
properties.note: ELF37 uses 0.0809 * 1.081 of a broad Pickwick residual. ELF50/51 subtract estimated Bishop total from Pickwick, then split 0.3666 / 0.6334. ELF52 uses 0.1445 of the SAME Wilson/Pickwick source, although its nominal basin lies below Pickwick.

properties.name: BOONE_KINGSPORT
properties.note: Combined local apportioned: ELF06 = 0.8287 * combined; ELF07 = 0.2067 * ELF06. Header areas 445 and 92 mi2.

properties.name: CLINTON_MELTON
properties.note: Melton Hill total inflow minus routed Norris release, split 0.3341 / 0.6659 (144 / 287 mi2).

properties.name: COPPERHILL_PROXY
properties.note: Copperhill ELF = 0.4615 * (Ocoee No. 3 inflow - routed Blue Ridge release), then negative-value adjustments. Proxy support exceeds nominal Copperhill incremental basin.

properties.name: DECATUR_WHEELER
properties.note: Decatur estimated total flow uses 0.6637 of combined Wheeler local plus upstream flows; later subtraction/disaggregation produces ELF48. ELF49 subtracts that reconstructed Decatur total and Prospect. Related, but not exact scaled copies.

properties.name: FORTLOUDOUN_TELLICO
properties.note: Combined Fort Loudoun + Tellico inflow minus Douglas, Cherokee, Chilhowee releases and Sevierville/Maryville flows. Shares: Tellico 0.4040; Knoxville 0.3605; Fort Loudoun 0.2355. Nominal areas 650 / 580 / 379 mi2.

properties.name: HIWASSEE_APALACHIA
properties.note: Combined local apportioned: ELF19 = 0.9187 * combined; ELF20 = 0.0885 * ELF19. Header local areas 565 / 50 mi2.
